summary_en: Kiran, a working professional from Hyderabad, called to compare Python and SQL/PowerBI courses and asked about evening or weekend batches, fees, duration, eligibility, instalments, course coverage, placement support, salary expectations, study materials, certificates, and possible hidden charges. The agent explained that only an 8-week Python with Data Analytics course is available, priced at ₹8,999 upfront with no instalment option. Weekday classes run 8–9 PM and weekend classes run Saturday and Sunday 10 AM–1 PM. Graduates or final-year students with basic computer knowledge are eligible. The course includes Python and hands-on projects but not SQL. Placement assistance consists of resume building, interview preparation, and referrals, with no guaranteed number of interviews, salary promise, or job guarantee. The agent could not confirm whether study materials and certificates were included or whether extra charges applied. Kiran provided his name, email, and graduation qualification, but withheld batch preference and declined to save the enquiry until those cost and inclusion details were confirmed. The agent said they would check with the team but could not provide a confirmation timeframe, reference number, or update process, and also could not provide SQL/PowerBI details. Kiran ended the call without registering, requesting confirmation first.
next_action: Do not contact this number. The caller opted out.
